# Source fixtures

`activity/doe-delay.json` captures the DOE proceeding used to check publication classification, history linkage, and effective-date delays. It contains one original direct final rule and five delay notices, including document `2026-13305`. Tests freeze the assessment date at September 21, 2026; this fixture is historical evidence, not a live status claim.

Curated examples contain publication links only and run live research. No saved responses are served from `public/examples`. See [live examples](../../docs/curated-examples.md).
